title: 2022 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 10
statement: Let \(S\) be a set of size 11. A random 12 -tuple \(\left(s_{1}, s_{2}, \ldots, s_{12}\right)\) of elements of \(S\) is chosen uniformly at random. Moreover, let \(\pi: S \rightarrow S\) be a permutation of \(S\) chosen uniformly at random. The probability that \(s_{i+1} \neq \pi\left(s_{i}\right)\) for all \(1 \leq i \leq 12\) (where \(s_{13}=s_{1}\) ) can be written as \(\frac{a}{b}\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are relatively prime positive integers. Compute \(a\).
